gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i1: Tests {@link BoundedReader#read(char[], int, int)} when the caller asks for more characters than the configured bound allows.
ADDED i2: Characters that the underlying reader could supply if it were not bounded.
ADDED i3: Upper limit on how many characters the BoundedReader is allowed to return.
ADDED i4: Request 4 characters into a buffer pre-filled with a sentinel ('X') so we can tell which slots were actually written by the read.
ADDED i5: The reader is bounded to 3 characters, so only 3 are returned even though 4 were requested.
ADDED i6: The first three slots hold the bounded content; the fourth keeps its sentinel value.
